title: Signature NaN Bloodhound
description: Signature original — a bloodhound that sniffs out NaN origins by binary-searching the trace: it replays halves until the NaN appears, converging on the source operator logarithmically. The hound finds in seconds what linear walks find in hours.

demo.code:
ops = 1024
import math
steps = math.ceil(math.log2(ops))
print("operators:", ops, "bloodhound steps:", steps)

title: Signature Straggler Hound
description: Signature original — sniffs out straggler ranks by comparing per-step traces across the fleet and flagging statistical outliers. The hound distinguishes slow hardware from slow data loading by trace signature. Fixes target the true cause.

demo.code:
times = [10.1, 10.3, 10.0, 45.2, 10.2]
mean = sum(times) / len(times)
out = [t for t in times if t > 2 * mean]
print("outliers:", out, "-> rank 3 straggler")
